about_the_game:
CEREBRUM Remastered - Awaken Alone. Fight Your Friends. Save Them.

Description:
Greyne awakens from a long slumber to find a world plunged into nightmare. The vile RESERVE and his mysterious accomplice have trapped every inhabitant in an eternal bad dream. Greyne's friends are no longer themselves; their fears and pain have twisted them into terrifying monsters.

But within this despair lies a spark of hope: Greyne discovers that by defeating these monsters, he can free the captured souls. Each conquered boss transforms back and joins him as a playable character with unique powers.

Gear up, unite the strength of the rescued, and venture deeper into the heart of the nightmare to stop RESERVE and his sinister ally once and for all.

What awaits you:

  • A Nightmare You Must Escape From: Face the monstrous versions of your friends in boss battles that will leave you restless.

  • Awaken Your Allies: Unlock each defeated boss as a playable character, rousing them from their nightmare sleep to utilize their unique abilities.

  • United We Stand, Asleep We Fall: Combine your team's powers to explore new dreamlike realms!

  • Wake Your Brain!: Master challenging 2D puzzle-platformers that require wit and skill, promising hopefully not too many sleepless nights.

Shatter the Nightmare. Fight your friends to save them. Defy RESERVE.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 (64-bit) or Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2130 oder AMD FX-4300
  • Memory: 10 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics like Intel HD Graphics 520 or a dedicated GPU with at least 1GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 9.0c
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4670K oder AMD Ryzen 3 1300X
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 950, AMD Radeon R7 370
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible

short_description: Fight the nightmare monsters that your friends have become, free them, and awaken a team with unique powers to defeat the evil.
